file_impact.reason: The defect and the fix: relocate the comment block out of the continued recipe line, rejoin set -e to the body so bug 1738's protection actually governs the provisioning steps, and change the default target directory to .rebar/worktrees/<name>.
New guard: expands the worktree recipe with make -n and feeds it to sh -n, so any recipe-quoting or line-continuation defect fails the build. Depends on no CI provider.
Line 441 documents `git worktree add ../<name>`, a sibling path the sandbox refuses to write; update it to match the target's new default.
Carries the same sibling-path worktree instruction and must agree with the Makefile default.
